local_capture.method: Chromium headless via local Playwright against frozen original over loopback HTTP
local_capture.capture_note: Local capture executed on the rollout working tree (base head + this branch's SRC060 harness/driver changes); the accepted record is bound to the source authority SHA256, not to a clean-code CI artifact.

input_timing_policy.rule: No pointer input is applied before window.__LT60__.clusterProjection(0) is non-null (first draw frame). Applied identically to original and split.
input_timing_policy.source_native_defect: nearestHit() can read the sparse clusterProjected array before the first draw() fills it when pointermove arrives before the first animation frame (TypeError).
input_timing_policy.classification: SOURCE_NATIVE_DEFECT; NOT caused by mechanical split; NOT repaired during split (source repair is out of scope).

determinism_policy.camera: focusCluster/selectNode fly animations are allowed to complete under prefers-reduced-motion, then the camera is pinned to exact source values before each capture.
determinism_policy.toast: cleared and 450ms CSS-transition settle plus two animation frames before each capture.
determinism_policy.screenshots: raw PNGs retained as evidence; comparison digest is a canonical pixel digest (16x16 downsample, channels floored to /16) because the source's backdrop-filter blur compositing is +/-1 channel nondeterministic even over a static canvas.

source_qa.cross_track_navigation: SOURCE_NATIVE HOLD (V1.2 handoff routes open real Track 55/56/59 URLs; not exercised during baseline or parity capture)

visual_review: Source-native 3D moment-cluster canvas, glass panels and four action modals reviewed from captured PNGs at all three viewports; behavior matches Drive 검증결과.json QA record.
